bio_text: Steven Enamakel is a serial DeFi founder turned AI builder, best known for creating MahaDAO (ARTH stablecoin) and now building TinyHumans AI — an open-source personal AI agent powered by brain-inspired memory systems. He is a hands-on technical founder with deep roots in DeFi protocol design, smart contract security, and TypeScript/Rust engineering, currently pivoting toward consumer AI products that are private, local, and UI-first.
